--- old
#!/bin/bash

# Deployment directories
MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/html/main"
DEV_DEPLOY_DIR="/var/www/html/dev"

# Git repository directory
REPO_DIR="/git/project.git"

# Read standard input to get ref information
while read oldrev newrev refname
do
    # Get branch name
    branch=$(echo $refname | sed 's/refs\/heads\///')
    
    # Create a temporary directory for checkout
    TMP_DIR=$(mktemp -d)
    
    # Deploy based on branch
    if [ "$branch" = "main" ]; then
        echo "Deploying main branch to $MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR"
        git --work-tree="$TMP_DIR" --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" checkout -f "$branch"
        rsync -aq --delete "$TMP_DIR/" "$MAIN_DEPLOY_DIR/"
        echo "Main branch deployed successfully"
        
    elif [ "$branch" = "dev" ]; then
        echo "Deploying dev branch to $DEV_DEPLOY_DIR"
        git --work-tree="$TMP_DIR" --git-dir="$REPO_DIR" checkout -f "$branch"
        rsync -aq --delete "$TMP_DIR/" "$DEV_DEPLOY_DIR/"
        echo "Dev branch deployed successfully"
    fi
    
    # Clean up temporary directory
    rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"
    
    # Ensure deployment completes within 3 seconds
    sleep 0.1  # Small delay to ensure file operations complete
done

echo "Deployment completed"
